profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent video editors may value removing inactive footage; this launch post gives no buyer or payment evidence.

candidates.reason: The launch text identifies a concrete export task, but supplies no implementation evidence for chat access or format conversion. The provisional scores are below the publication bar, so this is not proposed.

rejected.title: Remove inactive sections from sample videos
rejected.reason: Assessed a bounded sample-video edit using operator-supplied clips and human review of every proposed cut. The launch text names removal of still/inactive sections but supplies no method or implementation reference; the provisional assessment does not meet the publication bar.

rejected.title: Export AI chats to portable formats
rejected.reason: Assessed a small sample export to a selected destination with a person checking completeness and confidential content. The launch text names bulk export formats, but no supplied implementation source supports chat access or reliable conversion; the provisional assessment does not meet the publication bar.

rejected.title: Map political positions across multiple axes
rejected.reason: The assigned post only identifies a client-side political spectrum mapper. It does not state a concrete existing manual chore, request, or business problem to adapt; proposing one would invent demand and a professional-services buyer.

rejected.title: Restore access to a locked Shopify account
rejected.reason: The assigned post says account access is blocked, preventing order management and other operations. This is an access/recovery problem requiring platform authorization; the evidence supplies no bounded repeatable task an AI service could perform, and an AI workflow cannot restore account permissions.

steps.message: Assessed all four sealed discussion assignments. Two concrete product tasks received five provisional criterion ratings and explicit rejections; the mapper lacks a stated chore, and the account lockout has no automatable task in the evidence. No proposal clears the current rubric.
